decision: B40 is independently established as the smallest tested stable selected-information budget among B20 and B40 for the exact five-route LayerCake v25 architecture. This is a development-data information-boundary result, not Phase 4 certification.
authorized_next_action: Measure an exact B40 signed artifact on CPU and GPU with cold/warm TTFT, repeated throughput, active memory, output identity, and sparse-route evidence; then run B40-matched LoRA and distillation comparisons under equal imported-information accounting.
claim_boundary: Independently verified development minimum only among the exact tested B20 and B40 five-route budgets. Runtime, matched baselines, external human review, final test, Phase 4, and ABI superiority remain open.
